understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to place every selectable piece simultaneously on a goal tile marked '+', completing all levels.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move one grid cell (3 pixels) per directional action when not blocked. Walls and boundaries can prevent movement, while adjacent pushable blocks may move when pushed. CLICK switches control between selectable pieces using their pixel coordinates; all pieces must be positioned on goals at the same time. Movement hints indicate nearby objects but do not always guarantee that movement is impossible.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to place every selectable piece simultaneously on a goal tile marked '+', completing all levels.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move one grid cell (3 pixels) per directional action when not blocked. Walls and boundaries can prevent movement, while adjacent pushable blocks may move when pushed. CLICK switches control between selectable pieces using their pixel coordinates; all pieces must be positioned on goals at the same time. Movement hints indicate nearby objects but do not always guarantee that movement is impossible.
